name: foodx-monorepo
description: FoodX - Scalable Food Donation & Food Rescue Platform Monorepo

scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/shared-types run build && npm --prefix packages/validation run build && npm --prefix packages/config run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --project apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit

author: FoodX Team
